system_overview: This module contains two machine-checked proofs that the double of any natural number is even (that is, for any natural number, adding it to itself yields an even result). The first proof dispatches the entire obligation to the Z3 SMT solver in a single step. The second proof proceeds step-wise by making a case distinction on whether the number is even or odd, using modular arithmetic reasoning in each case.
actors_and_components: There are no actors or concurrent components. This is a purely mathematical proof module.
additional_assumptions: The proofs rely on the TLA Proof System (TLAPS) and its SMT solver backends. Evenness is defined as a number whose remainder when divided by two is zero, and oddness as a remainder of one.
